message: And sir I requested you something
Great man of God I want to share something with you U know many people and children's suffering from heat stroke
Some children's are from bricks factory children's and people Even they not able to do work Their families has not food for eating
In this days They all are hand to mouth Here is temperature is 55°C or some times more
We need your argent help for them
Keep remembering this children's
reply: 🙏 Sorry, I have nothing that I can give you at this time.
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ : 
🙏 May the LORD have His will done! 🕊️
May the LORD heal and protect the people and the children!
May the LORD free the children from brick factories!
May the LORD feed their families!
May the LORD provide for these people!
May the LORD help you!
May the LORD lead others to provide you with an abundance of prayer!
May the LORD lead you to someone who will abundantly provide whatever you ask the same day you ask!
Amen! 🙏
